The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!
But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested…
“Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
“Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.
But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would…

translations.web: Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.”
translations.bsb: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.”
translations.kjv: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
translations.asv: Therefore now, O Jehovah, take, I beseech thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.
